name: GraphRAG-QA multi-document demo set
description: Hand-written questions over the five bundled documents in data/samples/documents. Gold evidence strings are exact substrings of the documents; the evaluator maps them to whatever chunks contain them under the current chunk settings. 'bridge' questions need facts from two different documents; 'unanswerable' questions test the insufficient-evidence safeguard.
license: Questions and documents written for this project (CC BY 4.0).

questions.question: From which university did the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics laureate from the University of Toronto receive his PhD?
gold_evidence: Geoffrey E. Hinton of the University of Toronto
He then completed a PhD in artificial intelligence at the University of Edinburgh in 1978

questions.question: In which city was the AI company co-founded by a 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry laureate founded?
gold_evidence: jointly to Demis Hassabis and John M. Jumper of Google DeepMind
DeepMind Technologies was founded in London in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg and Mustafa Suleyman

questions.question: Which co-founder of DNNresearch later became chief scientist of OpenAI?
gold_evidence: Hinton, Krizhevsky and Sutskever then founded the start-up DNNresearch
Ilya Sutskever became the organisation's chief scientist

questions.question: Which award did the scientist who supervised Ilya Sutskever's PhD share with Yann LeCun?
gold_evidence: Sutskever completed his PhD at the University of Toronto under Hinton's supervision
Yoshua Bengio, Geoffrey Hinton and Yann LeCun were the recipients of the 2018 ACM A.M. Turing Award

questions.question: Which company acquired the London AI lab whose chief executive shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry?
gold_evidence: jointly to Demis Hassabis and John M. Jumper of Google DeepMind

questions.question: In which city was the AlphaGo match against Lee Sedol held?
gold_evidence: in a five-game match held in Seoul, South Korea

questions.question: When was the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics announced?
gold_evidence: On 8 October 2024, the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced that the Nobel Prize in Physics

questions.question: Where was Yann LeCun born?
gold_evidence: Yann LeCun was born in 1960 in Soisy-sous-Montmorency

questions.question: Which deep learning team merged with the company that developed AlphaGo to form Google DeepMind?
answer_aliases: Google Brain, the deep learning team of Google Research
gold_evidence: DeepMind's program AlphaGo defeated Lee Sedol
DeepMind merged with Google Brain, the deep learning team of Google Research

questions.question: Which organisation was founded first, DeepMind or OpenAI?
gold_evidence: DeepMind Technologies was founded in London in 2010
OpenAI was founded in December 2015 in San Francisco
